offertory collectors october vigil: sunday: michael mcdonagh / martin brogan / gina stenson joe davitt/ anthony ruane / gerry moran november vigil: sunday: martin mcdonagh / seamus coleman / bernadette reape ben burke / siobhan moran/jerome coleman this sunday is world mission sunday . it is the pope’s annual appeal in support of overseas missions. it takes place in every parish worldwide. many thanks for your contributions in your mission envelope this weekend . it will be a great help to all missionaries. invitation to get involved: at the recent meeting of the parish pastoral council, the desire for greater lay participation in our weekend parish masses was discussed . we would love to see more families and parishioners getting involved. there are a number of waysy can participate, including: reading at mass , leading the prayers of the faithful or bringing up the gifts of bread and wine . this can be especially meaningful at month’s mind or anniversary masses, when family members may wish to take part in remembering and praying for a loved one. we warmly invite you to consider getting involved. it would be wonderful to see more people taking an active part in our weekend masses. if you would like to participate, please contact fr. padraig or any member of the parish pastoral council. bereavement support group in ballina: a bereavement support group meeting will be held at the newman institute, ballina on the second wednesday of each month (october-may), starting on 14th october at 8pm. trained facilitators conduct the meetings, which provide guidance and support to all who find loss difficult. all are welcome. further information from monica morley, knock shrine on
